author: Bryan Rought
title: Account deletion is unnecessarily difficult
content:
I enjoyed the game initially, but the account deletion process was unlike anything I’ve encountered in a mobile game. I had to submit a form containing numerous account details, wait for a manual review, and was told by support that my information would be verified within 4 days. More than two weeks later my account was still active and I had received no indication that the deletion had been approved.

I contacted support again and was then told it had been approved. I had to return to the game, navigate back to the deletion page, confirm deletion, enter my email address twice, confirm again, and then wait another 24 hours for deletion to complete.

Account deletion should not require this many steps or repeated follow-ups. I have screenshots documenting the entire process. This experience is why I cannot recommend the game.

author: DrKeno
title: No Ads? True! Game play like the ads sample? No!
content:
The ads for this game appear consistently in my other games I play. They promise no ads in the game. This part is true. However, the sample game play you experience is nothing close to the game play in the game itself.  

In this game you are building a town and defending it. However you are not walking around collecting resources and converting them into good to meet a line of customers in a cartoon style format. Not are you collecting the cash and building up your defenses to take on a horde of the invading forces as you see in the ad or sample play. 

If the ad gets you to your App Store, look at the samples in the App Store postings as it shows the actual game style. Don’t replying the ad and ad sample play alone to decide to download this app.
